translation.name: Biblica® Open Nkanda wu Moyo, Nguizani Yimona ayi Minkunga 2002
translation.englishName: Yombe: Biblica® Open Nkanda wu Moyo, Nguizani Yimona ayi Minkunga 2002 (Bible)

content.text: Bika Nzambi katelama ;
bika bambeni bandi zisasukusu ayi bobo beti kunlenda
bantina va ntualꞌandi.
Banga bueti lalikinina muisi mu phemo, bika wuba lalikisa ;
banga bueta siutila sile
ku mbazu
bika batu bambimbi babungana va meso ma Nzambi.
Vayi bika batu basonga bamona khini ;
ayi bayangalala va ntuala Nzambi,
bika bamona mayangi ayi khini yingolo.
Yimbidilanu Nzambi ; yimbidilanu minzitusu mu diambu di dizina diandi ;
yayisanu mutu wowo wundiatila va phunda mu matuti
Dizina diandi Yave ;
ayi lumona khini va ntualꞌandi.
Nzambi niandi widi dise di bisana ayi
niandi weti nuanina mafuola.
Mu buangu kiandi kinlongo kioki keti vuanda.
Nzambi wumvananga dikanda kuidi bobo
badi bawu veka ;
niandi weti tuadisa basi nloko mu ngimbudulu
vayi bankua matingu bawu banzingilanga mu ntoto wu yuma.
Mu thangu wutuaminina
batu baku ku ntuala, a Nzambi,
mu thangu mu dikanga,
ntoto wunikuka, diyilu dinokisa mvula va ntualꞌaku.
Va ntuala Nzambi, mutu wu Sinayi
va ntuala Nzambi, Nzambi yi Iseli.
Ngeyo wunokisa masala mawombo, a Nzambi ;
ngeyo wukindisa kiuka kiaku mu thangu kivonga.
Batu baku bavuanda muawu
A Nzambi, mu mamboti maku,
ngeyo wukubika bima mu diambu di nsukami.
Yave wutuba diambu dimosi :
batu bawombo bamonika mu yamikisa mawu.
Mintinu ayi minkangu mi masodi
milembo tini mu thinu nsualu,
mu bika bi batu, batu bakabula biobi baziona mu mvita.
Lukidi kueno leki va khatitsika bidikulu bi bibulu
mavavi ma dibembi diama mavindu palata,
zitsala ziandi zivindu nolo yilembo lezama.
Thangu Nzambi nkua ngolo yoso kasasikisa mintinu va ntoto,
yiba banga yi matadi ma phembi.
Miongo mi Basani midi miongo mi nzitusu ;
miongo mi Basani midi miongo midi zitsongi ziwombo.
A bila mbi luntadila mu kikhenene,
e beno miongo midi zitsongi ziwombo ;
mongo wowo kasobula mu yadila,
kuna niandi veka Yave kela vuandanga mu zithangu zioso.
Matoma ma mvita
ma Yave
madi dikumi di zimili ayi zimili yi zimili ;
Yave wutotukila ku Sinayi mu buangu kiandi kinlongo.
Thangu wukuma ku yilu,
wunata mu ntandꞌaku batu bakangama.
Wutambula makaba kuidi batu ayi kuidi bankua matingu
muingi ngeyo, a Yave Nzambi wuvuanda kuna.
Nzitusu kuidi Yave, kuidi Nzambi mvulusi eto.
Niandi weti kutunatina bizitu bieto lumbu ka lumbu.
Niandi Nzambi wukutuvananga phulusu.
Nzambi eto widi Nzambi weti vukisa.
Yave, mutu wumvanganga momo kazodidi, wumvukisanga mu lufua.
Bukiedika, Nzambi wela kosikisa mintu mi bambeni bandi ;
wela kosikisa mintu mi batu bobo badi zitsuki ziwombo,
bobo bandiatilanga mu masumu mawu.
Pfumu tubidi :
“Ndiela kuba totula mu Basani,
ndiela kuba totula ku tsina yi mbu,
Muingi wubuika malu maku mu menga
ma bobo beti kulenda ayi ludimi lu zimbua ziaku
lubaka kuku kiawu.”
Ndiatulu aku yimonika, a Nzambi.
Ndiatulu yi Nzambi ama,
ayi yi ntinu ama mu buangu kinlongo.
Minyimbidi miba ku ntuala ;
bosi minsiki mi miziki miba landakana,
miba va kimosi bana ba baketo bansika zindungu.
Bika luzitisa Nzambi mu lukutukunu lunneni,
Luzitisa Yave mu dikabu di Iseli !
Kuna kuidi dikanda di fioti di Benzami, wuba tuadisa,
kuna kuba batu bawombo banneni ba Yuda
ayi batu banneni ba Zabuloni ayi ba Nefitali.
Tumina lulendo luaku, a Nzambi.
Wutumonisa zingolo ziaku, a Nzambi
banga bobo wutuama vangila.
Mu diambu di nzo aku ku Yelusalemi ;
mintinu miela kunatina makaba.
Tubidila bulu va khatitsika masoso
nkangu zingombi zi mbakala va khatitsika
bana zingombi
zi makanda.
Bu kakululu, wulenda nata bitini bi palata.
Sasikisa makanda mona khini mu
nuana mvita !
Batu bafidusu bela totukila mu Ezipite ;
Kusi wela kukiyekula niandi veka ku tsi minsua mi Nzambi.
Yimbidilanu Nzambi beno bipfumu bi ntoto ;
yimbilanu minzitusu kuidi Yave ;
Kuidi mutu wowo wundiatila banga va mbata phunda
mu diyilu, mu diyilu di khulu.
Mutu wowo wulembo dumu mu mbembo yi lulendo.
Luyamikisa lulendo lu Nzambi
nzitusu andi widi va mbata Iseli
lulendo luandi luidi mu matuti.
Tsisi widi, a Nzambi,
mu buangu kiaku kinlongo.
Nzambi yi Iseli niandi weti vana lulendo
ayi zingolo kuidi batu bandi.
Nzitusu wuba kuidi Nzambi.

footnotes.text: 68.2 Sile: phila mafuta mansadulungu mu mafuta ma niosi ; meti vindungu mu mabaya.
68.30 Bulu va khatitsika masoso: dinsundula Ezipite
68.30 Zingombi zi mbakala va khatitsika bana zingombi: dinsundula bapfumu ba Ezipite.
